title: Run key payload
description: The payload of a run key, the exact JSON bytes Qory Apiary signed. A run key is qrk_, the payload in base64url without padding, a dot, and the signature in base64url without padding, at most 2048 characters with no white space; the signature is 64 bytes of Ed25519 under Qory Apiary's server key over qory-run-key-ed25519-v1, a line feed and the payload bytes. Qory Apiary answers a run's registration with one when the registering node's or node pool's choice resolves to a gateway. A gateway and Qory Apiary verify the signature under the pinned server key whose fingerprint signer names, then read the payload against this schema; a runner pins no server key, reads the payload against this schema alone, and takes run_id, gateway_url and gateway_public_key from it, which grants nothing.

signer.description: The fingerprint of the server key that signed the run key, as an enrolment code names keys: base64url without padding of the first 16 bytes of SHA-256 over the raw public key, 22 characters. A server key can rotate inside a live run.

run_id.description: The run's id: a UUID in the canonical lower-case form.

workspace.description: The run's workspace, from the registering node's or node pool's record.

node_id.description: The node, nd_, or node pool, np_, that registered the run. Any of its active keys may give the run's outcome.

gateway.description: The gateway the node's choice resolved to at this registration, ng_: the one gateway the run attaches at.

gateway_url.description: Where the edge reaches the gateway, at most 300 characters: https://, a host and an optional port, and nothing after them. The host is DNS labels joined by dots, each 1 to 63 letters, digits and hyphens that starts and ends with a letter or a digit, which covers a dotted IPv4 address and a name with no dot, or an IPv6 address in brackets; it has no user information, no underscore, no trailing dot and no percent-encoding. A port is a colon and a decimal number from 1 to 65535 with no leading zero. The only address the run key is ever sent to.

gateway_public_key.description: The gateway's live Ed25519 keys, current then next.

public_key.description: A raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding.

instance_id.description: The registration's signed instance id, X-Qory-Instance-Id of the registration.

issued.description: When Qory Apiary made the run key, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. A runner never checks it.

attach_by.description: The end of the attach window, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds: the window the registration's attach_seconds asked for, bounded by the server. A runner never checks it.
